privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.technical.heading: Technical data
privacy.technical.body: To protect the forms and reactions from spam, I keep a hashed fingerprint of your IP address for a few minutes, never the IP itself. Reactions only store counts. Your browser only keeps your preferences (language, theme, keyboard shortcuts, the reactions you marked and how many times you woke up the “Careful, do not touch” buddy). I use no analytics or tracking cookies.
privacy.providers.heading: Model arena: Google, Anthropic and OpenAI
privacy.providers.body: The pregenerated part of the AI Lab arena sends nothing. If you sign in and accept the notice, the text of your task, up to 1,000 characters, goes to three providers so they can be compared: Google (Gemini), Anthropic (Claude) and OpenAI. My server sends them only the task, never your name or your email, and it does not store the text: in the site database it keeps a per-account counter for the daily limit, which deletes itself the next day, and the month’s spend per provider, which does not say who made it. I use the paid APIs of all three; according to their terms, what is sent through the API is not used to train their models. The other demos that use these providers warn you the same way before sending.
